correctness.rationale: The Dold divisibility for all n reduces to prime-power local congruences with coprime complementary t. Integer powers settle primes outside 2,3,5. For exceptional primes the weighted power differences normalized by p^r must vanish mod p^h (h=8,3,1); period P=(p−1)p^h in t for units, high-t divisibility for p|j, and p-adic lifting Q_{r+1}≡Q_r mod p^{r−1} for r≥h+3 reduce every index to a finite complete certificate. Independent integer modular arithmetic checked 6752 bounded cells for k12/13. Dold denominator witnesses have lcm 13860, establishing minimality; Stirling growth yields positive Mobius transforms.
